Introduction

Base URL: https://api.sipanda.online 
This documentation aims to provide all the information you need to work with our API.

<aside>As you scroll, you'll see code examples for working with the API in different programming languages in the dark area to the right (or as part of the content on mobile).
You can switch the language used with the tabs at the top right (or from the nav menu at the top left on mobile).</aside>

Authenticating requests

This API is not authenticated.

Endpoints

Public OPD registration endpoint

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "https://api.sipanda.online/api/opd/register" \
    --header "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --form "opd_name=b"\
    --form "opd_code=n"\
    --form "opd_address=architecto"\
    --form "opd_phone=ngzmiyvdljnikhwa"\
    --form "admin_name=y"\
    --form "admin_email=gilbert32@example.com"\
    --form "admin_password=architecto"\
    --form "admin_phone=ngzmiyvdljnikhwa"\
    --form "logo=@/tmp/phpa7vdbn2q92fmeoZUzAj" 
const url = new URL(
    "https://api.sipanda.online/api/opd/register"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

const body = new FormData();
body.append('opd_name', 'b');
body.append('opd_code', 'n');
body.append('opd_address', 'architecto');
body.append('opd_phone', 'ngzmiyvdljnikhwa');
body.append('admin_name', 'y');
body.append('admin_email', 'gilbert32@example.com');
body.append('admin_password', 'architecto');
body.append('admin_phone', 'ngzmiyvdljnikhwa');
body.append('logo', document.querySelector('input[name="logo"]').files[0]);

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body,
}).then(response => response.json());

Request      

POST api/opd/register

Headers

Content-Type        

Example: multipart/form-data

Accept        

Example: application/json

Body Parameters

opd_name   string     

OPD Data. Must not be greater than 255 characters. Example: b

opd_code   string     

Must not be greater than 50 characters. Example: n

opd_address   string  optional    

Example: architecto

opd_phone   string  optional    

Must not be greater than 20 characters. Example: ngzmiyvdljnikhwa

admin_name   string     

Admin User Data (will also be used as OPD email). Must not be greater than 255 characters. Example: y

admin_email   string     

Must be a valid email address. Example: gilbert32@example.com

admin_password   string     

Example: architecto

admin_phone   string  optional    

Must not be greater than 20 characters. Example: ngzmiyvdljnikhwa

logo   file  optional    

Must be a file. Must be an image. Must not be greater than 2048 kilobytes. Example: /tmp/phpa7vdbn2q92fmeoZUzAj

Login user and create token

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "https://api.sipanda.online/api/login" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"email\": \"gbailey@example.net\",
    \"password\": \"architecto\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "https://api.sipanda.online/api/login"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "email": "gbailey@example.net",
    "password": "architecto"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Register a new citizen (taxpayer)

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "https://api.sipanda.online/api/citizen/register" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"nik\": \"bngzmiyvdljnikhw\",
    \"name\": \"architecto\",
    \"password\": \"]|{+-0pBNvYg\",
    \"address\": \"architecto\",
    \"phone\": \"architecto\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "https://api.sipanda.online/api/citizen/register"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "nik": "bngzmiyvdljnikhw",
    "name": "architecto",
    "password": "]|{+-0pBNvYg",
    "address": "architecto",
    "phone": "architecto"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

    method: "GET",
